```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
workdir <- getwd()
set.seed(params$seed)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(knitr)
library(rmarkdown)
library(utils)
options(encoding="UTF-8")
options(show.signif.stars=TRUE)
# non permanent command
load(file.path(workdir,".RData"))
source("/export/scratch2/Rplus/Rutility.R")
library(xtable)
options(xtable.floating = FALSE)
options(xtable.timestamp = "")
library(xlsx)

# additional functions
.cleanPackage <- function(keeplib){
  auxi <- search()
  auxi <- auxi[!is.element(auxi,keeplib)]
  sapply(auxi,function(x) try(detach(x,character.only = TRUE,unload=TRUE)))
  R.utils::gcDLLs()
}
cleanPackage <- function(...){
  suppressPackageStartupMessages(.cleanPackage(...))
}
RequirePB <- function(...){
  suppressPackageStartupMessages(require(...))
}
SourcePB <- function(...){
  suppressPackageStartupMessages(source(...)) 
}
gg_color_hue <- function(n) {
  hues = seq(15, 375, length = n + 1)
  hcl(h = hues, l = 65, c = 100)[1:n]
}
  
### color gradient
cols <- colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(n = 7, name ="RdYlBu")))(25)
```
